description: Monthly basic pay from the 2026 pay table for a pay grade and years of service, plus the annualized amount. Grade E1B is the special E-1 rate for the first 4 months of service. Combinations the table does not authorize return authorized=false with null pay. Use when the user wants basic pay for a pay grade and years of service from the 2026 table. For housing allowance use calculate_bah. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive military pay calculator.

pay_grade.description: Pay grade. E1B means E-1 with under 4 months of service.
